title: Run axe-core WCAG AA audit
description: Build site, serve on port 3099, run scripts/audit-a11y.mjs against all 7 pages, capture violations.

acceptance_criteria.description: axe-core reports zero WCAG 2.1 A/AA violations across all 7 audited pages

title: Run Lighthouse accessibility scan
description: Run scripts/lighthouse-score.mjs for accessibility category, capture scores for all 7 pages.

acceptance_criteria.description: Lighthouse accessibility score is >= 90 on all scored pages

title: Manual keyboard focus state audit
description: Review CSS for :focus-visible styles on all interactive elements. Check links, buttons, form inputs, nav items. Identify any missing focus indicators.

acceptance_criteria.description: All interactive elements have a visible focus indicator when keyboard-navigated

title: Manual color contrast verification
description: Check forest green #1a6b3c against all CSS backgrounds where it appears as text color. Verify 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.

acceptance_criteria.description: Primary-green text passes WCAG AA contrast minimums in all tested contexts

title: Verify safety-tier badge does not rely on color alone
description: Check ModuleMeta TIER badge renders both icon and text label. Confirm information is available without relying on color perception.

acceptance_criteria.description: Safety-tier TIER badge renders both text label and icon

title: Remediate all findings
description: Fix any violations, missing focus states, or contrast issues identified in T1-T5. Document each fix with file, change, and rationale.

acceptance_criteria.description: All findings are documented in build-report.md with remediation applied and verified

title: Re-run audit to confirm zero violations
description: Re-run axe-core and Lighthouse after remediation. Must produce zero violations and scores >= 90.

acceptance_criteria.description: axe-core reports zero WCAG 2.1 A/AA violations across all 7 audited pages (post-remediation)
Lighthouse accessibility score >= 90 on all scored pages (post-remediation)

title: Verify build passes
description: Run npm run build to confirm no compilation errors after all changes.
